system.description:
The Dancer is a rhythmic defiance against the encroaching dark. Clad in iridescent silks and ringing bells that cut through the gloom, you believe that as long as the heart beats a rhythm, the soul cannot be extinguished. You fight with a kinetic, swirling grace that inspires those around you to stand taller against the inevitable.

Class feature: Grace in Motion
If you move at least 20' during your turn, you defend with -2 DR until the start of your next turn and cannot be targeted by Opportune Attacks. This effect does not apply if you wear armour heavier than t1.

Class power: Dance Partner 🟒1 ◈◈
